description: Every ELF file in the Linux x64 deb, by path under installRoot, with its class. scripts/linux-native-scan.js fails on a missing or extra file, a changed pinned digest, a file whose ELF target contradicts its class, or a supported file (or a dormant prebuild selectedWhen PREBUILDS_ONLY=1) with a non-weak GLIBC need above glibcFloor. scripts/linux-packaging-gate.js runs the scan and the floor-image checks. A new ELF file, a class change or a changed pinned digest needs a reviewed commit here that says why. Only pinned downloads carry a sha256; source-built and npm-packaged files depend on the build, and the successor inspection's package comparison catches their changes.
glibcFloorReason: freedom-ipfs-node/freedom_ipfs_native.node needs GLIBC_2.39 (pidfd_getpid, pidfd_spawnp) and usb/build/Release/usb_bindings.node GLIBC_2.38, neither weak. package.json build.deb.depends declares libc6 (>= 2.39) to match.

classes.supported: x86-64 glibc (or static x86-64) files the app executes or loads on Linux x64.
classes.foreign: Built for another architecture or C library, so the Linux x64 glibc loader cannot select them. node-gyp-build matches prebuilds/<platform>-<arch> and the libc tag to the running process (node_modules/node-gyp-build/node-gyp-build.js:62-73,109-114,142-161).
classes.dormant: x86-64 glibc variants the app does not select, each with the code that keeps it unselected.

loaderSelection.assumption: PREBUILDS_ONLY, <NAME>_PREBUILD, LIBC, npm_config_arch and npm_config_platform are unset and /etc/alpine-release is absent (node_modules/node-gyp-build/node-gyp-build.js:9-35,196-197).
loaderSelection.prebuildsOnly: Under PREBUILDS_ONLY=1 node-gyp-build skips build/Release and loads the usb and keccak glibc prebuilds, so those two are held to the floor too and the gate's probes load them in that mode.
